01214233dffd.name: Keen Senses
01214233dffd.plain: Use in your Shooting phase. Choose a SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY, SPACE WOLVES BIKER or SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY unit of yours. For the rest of the turn, modifiers to hit rolls, Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill can be ignored (any or all of them), and so can any or all modifiers to charge rolls you make for that unit.

06582ef9388e.name: Fenrisian Great Axe (Scythe)
06582ef9388e.plain: For every attack with this weapon, make 2 hit rolls instead of 1 hit roll.

0aaa977f37ab.name: Aura of Majesty
0aaa977f37ab.plain:
Saga (Aura): Morale tests for your SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of this model are passed automatically.
Deed: this model starts your Command phase within range of an objective marker more than 6" away from your deployment zone.

0d2104998df0.name: Thane of the Retinue
0d2104998df0.plain: Once per battle, use before the battle while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the SPACE WOLVES keyword. Pick one SPACE WOLVES model from your army with 'Sergeant' or 'Pack Leader' in its profile. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER, it can have one of these Special-issue Wargear Relics: Master-crafted Weapon, Digital Weapons, Frost Weapon or Morkai's Teeth Bolts. Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't give a model two Relics.

13043bcee90d.name: Hard as Stone (Aura)
13043bcee90d.plain: Aura: while one of your NOVAMARINES CORE INFANTRY units is within 6" of this model, any attack with an Armour Penetration of -1 that is allocated to a model in that unit counts as having an Armour Penetration of 0 instead.

141d6d4d78a1.name: Death Frenzy
141d6d4d78a1.plain: Whenever a melee attack destroys a model in this unit, if that model hasn't fought this phase, don't remove it yet. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, and is removed from play afterwards.

18316784612c.name: Foehammer (melee)
18316784612c.plain: Add 1 to the Damage of any attack from this weapon that is allocated to a CHARACTER or MONSTER model.

19b17a8eb7f0.name: Supersonic
19b17a8eb7f0.plain: Whenever this model Advances, Falls Back or makes a Normal move, start by pivoting it on the spot by up to 90° (pivoting doesn't count towards how far it moves), then move it straight forwards. After that first pivot, it can't pivot again.

1aa28d95b273.name: Wulfen Frost claws
1aa28d95b273.plain: When the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon. Failed wound rolls for this weapon's attacks can be re-rolled.

1e0abf74a2c9.name: Objective Secured
1e0abf74a2c9.plain: Troops units in your ADEPTUS ASTARTES Detachments have Objective Secured: you control an objective marker if any of your models with this ability are within range of it, even when more enemy models are within range. If an enemy model within range also has this ability (or a similar one), control is decided as normal: whoever has more models within range controls it. At the end of your Command phase, each objective marker you control that has one of these Troops units within range stays yours even if your models move off it. It only stops being yours when your opponent controls it at the end of a later phase.

waive.2023: date of the dataslate that made the change, not part of the rule

21e56f8a19f9.name: Born of Wolves (Aura)
21e56f8a19f9.plain: Aura: each time one of your units with the SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY, SPACE WOLVES BEAST or SPACE WOLVES CHARIOT keyword fights while it is within 6" of this model, every model in that unit gets 1 extra attack using its teeth and claws or its crushing teeth and claws, or 2 extra attacks using its flurry of teeth and claws, until the fight is resolved.

223ac2c5930e.name: Staff of the Stormcaller
223ac2c5930e.plain: You can re-roll this model's Deny the Witch tests.

25c382e4d962.name: On the Scent
25c382e4d962.plain: Use at the start of your Charge phase. Pick one enemy unit that lost any wounds or had models destroyed this turn. Until the end of the turn, whenever one of your WOLFSPEAR CORE units makes a charge roll, you can re-roll it if that enemy unit was one of the targets of that charge.

2699633b15f5.name: Battlesmith
2699633b15f5.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model can pick one SPACE WOLVES VEHICLE within 1" of it and repair it, so that vehicle straight away regains D3 wounds lost earlier in the battle. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

2ae9256ff01e.name: Runic Wards
2ae9256ff01e.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, once an enemy PSYKER unit has passed a Psychic test. Choose a SPACE WOLVES unit of yours that is within 12" of that PSYKER unit; it can take a Deny the Witch test to try to deny that power, as though it were a PSYKER.

2c890d268659.name: Dark Terror
2c890d268659.plain:
Units with this tactic move faster and get light cover against shots from more than 18" away:
• Add 1 to Advance and charge rolls for units with this tactic.
• When a model more than 18" away makes a ranged attack against a unit with this tactic, that unit counts as having the benefits of light cover against it.

2cd0e26321b0.name: An Army of One
2cd0e26321b0.plain: This model can't ever have a Warlord Trait.

2d2017cdb2b2.name: Berserk Charge
2d2017cdb2b2.plain: This applies if this unit has the Hunters Unleashed Chapter Tactic, or if it has the Inheritors of the Primarch successor tactic and is using the Space Wolves Chapter Tactic. Whenever it fights, if it made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its models (excluding WOLF GUARD models) until that fight is resolved.

2f14036da6e1.name: Blacktooth
2f14036da6e1.plain: Swaps a combat knife or paired combat blades for Blacktooth, which has its own weapon profile. Only a model equipped with one of those can take this Relic.

3362246a1efd.name: Storm Caller
3362246a1efd.plain: Blessing (Aura), warp charge 6: if manifested, until the start of your next Psychic phase, SPACE WOLVES models from your army get the benefit of light cover while their unit is within 6" of this PSYKER.

3407e2095f5a.name: The Fierce-eye (Aura)
3407e2095f5a.plain: Aura: when a Combat Attrition test is taken for a model in an enemy unit within 3" of this model, subtract 1 from that test.

370ae1ca9e0c.name: Litany of Hate
370ae1ca9e0c.plain: If this litany is inspiring: while a SPACE WOLVES unit from your army is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll hit rolls for melee attacks made by its models.

3946d19a5193.name: Beastslayer
3946d19a5193.plain:
Saga (Aura): SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of this model add 1 to the wound roll of their melee attacks against VEHICLES or MONSTERS.
Deed: one of this model's attacks destroys an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.

3b618b838ee0.name: Black Death
3b618b838ee0.plain: Swaps the bearer's master-crafted power axe or power axe for Black Death, which has its own weapon profile. Only a model with one of those axes can take it.

3c9765bed75d.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
3c9765bed75d.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

3cebe4ec0a7d.name: Legendary Tenacity
3cebe4ec0a7d.plain: Roll one D6 whenever this model would lose a wound; on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

3e359318e1d1.name: Jump Pack Assault
3e359318e1d1.plain: If this model has a jump pack, then during deployment you can set it up high in the skies rather than on the battlefield. If you do, at the end of any of your Movement phases it can arrive with a sudden assault: place it anywhere more than 9" from every enemy model.

3e88579bbae5.name: Bestial Nature
3e88579bbae5.plain: Use in your Command phase, if your army has a combat doctrine active. Choose one unit from your army with the SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY, SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY or SPACE WOLVES BIKER keyword. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit benefits from the Assault Doctrine rather than the active combat doctrine.

3e9415ceca47.name: Black Death
3e9415ceca47.plain: When the bearer fights, it can make D6 extra attacks with this weapon.

3f2a9d17bf8c.name: ...Worthy of a Saga
3f2a9d17bf8c.plain: When this model attacks a CHARACTER or MONSTER in the Fight phase, a failed wound roll of 1 can be re-rolled.

412eb646c0d6.name: Pack Hunters

42b88eab23bb.name: Wolfkin
42b88eab23bb.plain:
Saga (Aura): your SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of this model always count as having made a charge move for the Shock Assault ability.
Deed: this model destroys an enemy model with a melee attack.

4b32289fa6eb.name: Lord of the Wolfkin (Aura)
4b32289fa6eb.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY or SPACE WOLVES BEAST units is within 6" of this model, the models in that unit can use this model's Leadership instead of their own.

4c6238eef91a.name: Huskarl to the Jarl
4c6238eef91a.plain: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for your SPACE WOLVES units while they are within 6" of this model.

4dad2c123640.name: Morkai's Howl (Aura)
4dad2c123640.plain: Aura: subtract 1 from Psychic tests taken for any enemy PSYKER unit within 18" of this unit, and subtract a further 1 if that PSYKER unit is within 6" of this unit.

533ef7c892a0.name: The Last Laugh
533ef7c892a0.plain: If, in the Fight phase, this model is killed by a melee attack from an enemy model, you and your opponent roll off. If you win, the attacking model's unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

5cc170ac02f2.name: Stalker Pack
5cc170ac02f2.plain: When choosing your army, make one SPACE WOLVES Detachment from your army a Stalker Pack Specialist Detachment. That Detachment's BATTLELEADERS, BLOOD CLAWS and REIVERS get the STALKER PACK keyword.

5e7503560ebc.name: Lord of Tempests
5e7503560ebc.plain: Add 1 to this model's Psychic tests.

5e75a88244af.name: Instincts Awoken
5e75a88244af.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6: if manifested, pick one SPACE WOLVES unit from your army within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, attacks made by models in that unit count the Assault Doctrine as active for them, instead of whichever doctrine is currently active. If your army already has the Assault Doctrine active, then each unmodified wound roll of 6 for those attacks improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1; this stacks with the Assault Doctrine's bonus.

5eef366be0a7.name: Spiritual Leader
5eef366be0a7.plain: During the Morale phase, any SPACE WOLVES unit of yours that is within 6" of this model may use this model's Leadership in place of its own.

5f2ee0c639ad.name: Aura of Majesty
5f2ee0c639ad.plain:
This WARLORD's litanies and four of its abilities reach 3" further, to a maximum of 9".
• Its Rites of Battle, Tactical Precision, Chapter Master and Spiritual Leaders abilities each get 3" more range (up to 9" at most).
• Any litany it recites gets 3" more range (up to 9" at most).

5f3ee8f5c224.name: Warrior Born
5f3ee8f5c224.plain:
Saga (Aura): at the start of the Fight phase, your SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of this model and in Engagement Range of enemies fight first that phase.
Deed: this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model with a melee attack.

5f53f96d90b5.name: Warrior of Legend
5f53f96d90b5.plain: Once per battle, use after you nominate a SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model that isn't a named character as your WARLORD. You can generate one more Warlord Trait for it, which must come from the Space Wolves Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (re-roll duplicates if generating randomly), and the model has access to the Saga tied to each of its Warlord Traits.

6240b08fb31b.name: Living Lightning
6240b08fb31b.plain: Witchfire, warp charge 6: if manifested, D3 mortal wounds are dealt to the closest enemy unit visible to this PSYKER and within 18" of it. Next, roll one D6. On a 2-4, the nearest other enemy unit that is visible to that first unit and within 6" of it takes 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

67ce636fd811.name: Battle-lust (Aura)
67ce636fd811.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever it consolidates, its models can move an extra 3".

6bf0e08764f3.name: Wolf Standard
6bf0e08764f3.plain: When a unit with a Wolf Standard Advances or makes a charge move, you can re-roll any dice that show a 1 for that move.

6d8a83eb58f2.name: Resolve of the Bear
6d8a83eb58f2.plain:
This WARLORD can shrug off lost wounds on a 6, and enemies can't re-roll wound or damage rolls against it.
• Roll one D6 whenever this WARLORD would lose a wound: on a 6, it doesn't lose that wound.
• For attacks made against this WARLORD, your opponent can't re-roll the wound roll or the damage roll.

6dd5c612f69e.name: Stalker Pack
6dd5c612f69e.plain: Use when choosing your army. Pick one SPACE WOLVES Detachment in your army to be a Stalker Pack Specialist Detachment. In that Detachment, BATTLE LEADERS, BLOOD CLAWS and REIVERS units gain the STALKER PACK keyword.

6df424a92f01.name: Blizzard shield
6df424a92f01.plain: A model with a blizzard shield has a 4+ invulnerable save.

6fd3a9b98788.name: The Storm's Eye
6fd3a9b98788.plain: LIBRARIAN only: once per turn, after resolving a Tempestas power the bearer manifested in your Psychic phase, roll one D6 per enemy unit within 12" of it. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

716a8634e55b.name: Chapter Master
716a8634e55b.plain: In your Command phase, choose a SPACE WOLVES CORE or SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit of yours within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, you can re-roll the hit roll for attacks made by that unit's models.

72f1a80d57b2.name: Master of Mischief
72f1a80d57b2.plain: This model can't be your Warlord and can't have a Warlord Trait.

73c75c7d07ea.name: Fenrisian Great Axe (Cleave)
73c75c7d07ea.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll for every attack made with this weapon.

77407e631572.name: The Emperor’s Executioners
77407e631572.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when you select a SPACE WOLVES unit of yours to fight. For the rest of the phase, when its models make melee attacks against THOUSAND SONS units, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

7d26a556082e.name: Pelt of the Doppegangrel
7d26a556082e.plain: Whenever an attack targets this unit, an unmodified hit roll of 1-3 always fails, whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

7ec48edf182a.name: Track and Hunt
7ec48edf182a.plain: Use at the end of your Movement phase. Choose a WOLFSPEAR CORE unit of yours and an enemy unit within 24" of it. For the rest of your turn, when a model in your unit attacks that enemy unit, the enemy unit doesn't get the benefits of cover against that attack.

7fff26934888.name: Relentless Assault
7fff26934888.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when a SPACE WOLVES unit of yours makes a consolidation move. For that move, each of its models can move up to 3" further. This can't be combined with any other rule that adds to how far models pile in or consolidate.

8203e4de16b7.name: Cloaked by the Storm
8203e4de16b7.plain: Use in your Psychic phase, once you have resolved a psychic power from the Tempestas discipline that a SPACE WOLVES PSYKER model in your army manifested. Until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack that targets one of your SPACE WOLVES units within 6" of that PSYKER model.

83d34f593e74.name: Headstrong
83d34f593e74.plain: If this unit has no WOLF GUARD model, then whenever it declares a charge, the closest eligible enemy unit must be one of the targets of that charge.

845822fa5bc5.name: Pack Mentality
845822fa5bc5.plain: If this unit has 6 or more models, add 1 to its Leadership; if it has 10 or more models, add 2 instead.

853678695f31.name: Actinic Halo
853678695f31.plain: This model has a 3+ invulnerable save. Once it fails a saving throw for the first time, that invulnerable save becomes 4+.

873793484567.name: Jaws of the World Wolf
873793484567.plain: Witchfire, warp charge 7: if manifested, choose an enemy unit visible to this PSYKER and within 18" of it. For each model in that unit, roll one D6, adding 1 to each roll if the Psychic test came to 9 or more. Each 6+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit.

87436e420686.name: Savage Strike
87436e420686.plain: Use in your Fight phase, when you select a SPACE WOLVES unit of yours to fight. If that unit made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the wound roll for each of its models' melee attacks until that fight is resolved. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, or 2CP if it has more.

87fc7e23a59a.name: Fireheart
87fc7e23a59a.plain: Swaps the bearer's plasma pistol for Fireheart, which has its own weapon profile. Only a model with a plasma pistol can take it.

880f1f98bf5c.name: Bestial Rage
880f1f98bf5c.plain: This unit can't perform any actions.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

89610dda4672.name: Murderlust
89610dda4672.plain: You can re-roll this unit's charge rolls.

89fe4d002f9f.name: A Trophy Bestowed
89fe4d002f9f.plain: Once per battle, use after you choose a model drawn from a Space Wolves successor Chapter as your WARLORD: you can give a CHARACTER model in your army from a Space Wolves successor Chapter one Relic of the Fang, in place of a Special-issue Wargear Relic or a Chapter Relic. If you do, any Space Wolves keyword on that Relic is replaced everywhere with that model's successor Chapter keyword.

8ae794f06e3d.name: Wolf Helm of Russ (Aura)
8ae794f06e3d.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 9" of this model, the models in that unit can use this model's Leadership instead of their own.

8d440edd440f.name: Howling Beast
8d440edd440f.plain: Add 2 to this WARLORD's Attacks characteristic while it is within Engagement Range of any enemy models whose Leadership characteristic is 7 or lower.

8e530ff2705e.name: Turbo-boost
8e530ff2705e.plain: When this model Advances, don't roll a dice: add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead.

8f6e261b71fe.name: War Howl (Aura)
8f6e261b71fe.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll that unit's charge rolls.

95379e078f6d.name: Runic Armour
95379e078f6d.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

9a443f3a2dee.name: Wulfen Howl (Aura)
9a443f3a2dee.plain: Aura: you can re-roll charge rolls for any of your SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY, SPACE WOLVES BIKER or SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY units while they are within 6" of this unit, and for any of your SPACE WOLVES BLOOD CLAWS units while they are within 12" of this unit.

9c2ba52fb2ad.name: Resolve of the Bear
9c2ba52fb2ad.plain:
Saga (Aura): roll one D6 whenever a model in one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of this model would lose a wound; on a 6, that wound isn't lost.
Deed: this model loses one or more wounds.

9d913f42ed89.name: Jarl of Fenris
9d913f42ed89.plain: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your SPACE WOLVES units while they are within 6" of this model.

9d9440600a8a.name: Murderous Hurricane

9db4858d890b.name: Hover Jet
9db4858d890b.plain: This model can hover in your Command phase. If it does, it loses the Airborne, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities and has a Move characteristic of 20" until your next Command phase starts.

9f73753a2888.name: Blacktooth
9f73753a2888.plain: When the bearer fights, it makes 2 extra attacks with this weapon. Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

a0f9e335dbe7.name: Crushing teeth and claws
a0f9e335dbe7.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 3 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can't make more than 3 attacks in total with this weapon.

a18cb84d78bc.name: Go for the Throat
a18cb84d78bc.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your army has the Assault Doctrine active, you can use this. Until your next Command phase, whenever a SPACE WOLVES model from your army attacks with a Pistol or a melee weapon and gets an unmodified wound roll of 6, improve that attack's Armour Penetration by 1, on top of any Combat Doctrine bonus.

a3b7ea92b4d0.name: Mountain-Breaker Helm
a3b7ea92b4d0.plain: After the bearer makes its close combat attacks, before it consolidates, you can pick one enemy unit within 3" of it and roll one D6. On a 2+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

a4a211ce8956.name: Slayer's Oath
a4a211ce8956.plain: If an attack made by this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER model, then for the rest of the battle, litanies this model recites are automatically inspiring; don't roll for them.

a81f8f6f1c97.name: Runic Totems
a81f8f6f1c97.plain: Enemy psychic powers can target this unit only if it is the closest enemy unit to the model manifesting the power. Also, roll one D6 whenever this unit would lose a wound in the Psychic phase; on a 4+, the wound isn't lost.

a96477c8d880.name: The Wulfen Stone
a96477c8d880.plain:
The bearer gives charge re-rolls to SPACE WOLVES CORE units within 6" of it and, once per battle, boosts a Savage Fury unit.
• Bestial Charge (Aura): while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll its charge rolls.
• Once per battle, the bearer can call on the spirits of the Wulfen at the start of the Fight phase. If it does, pick one of your SPACE WOLVES units within 6" of it with the Savage Fury ability. Until the phase ends, for every attack made by a model in that unit, Savage Fury's extra hit triggers on an unmodified roll of 5+.

ac7816ff72ed.name: Murder-maker
ac7816ff72ed.plain: You can re-roll this model's charge rolls. It gets 3 extra attacks from its Shock Assault ability, instead of 1 extra attack.

acd04199afe9.name: Priest
acd04199afe9.plain:
This model knows the Litany of Hate and one litany from the Litanies of Battle. At the start of each battle round, it can recite one litany it knows that no friendly model has recited yet that battle round. Roll one D6: on a 3+ the litany is inspiring and lasts until the end of that battle round.

Litany of Hate: if inspiring, then while a SPACE WOLVES unit from your army is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll hit rolls for melee attacks made by its models.

waive.59: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

b0117cf94bd3.name: Killing Blow
b0117cf94bd3.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select a WOLFSPEAR CORE unit of yours to shoot or fight. For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of an attack by one of its models if, at the moment the target was chosen, that target was below Half Strength, or had a Starting Strength of 1 and no more than half its wounds left.

b0eee602d4ff.name: Strike for the Throat
b0eee602d4ff.plain: For each melee attack this WARLORD makes, you can re-roll the hit roll, and the attack's Armour Penetration characteristic improves by 1.

b437c3549559.name: Hunters Beyond Death
b437c3549559.plain: When the target is a PSYKER, models in this unit ignore the Look Out, Sir rule. In addition, attacks a model in this unit makes against an enemy PSYKER unit get 1 added to their hit roll and 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

b5291a76f745.name: Champion of the Kingsguard
b5291a76f745.plain: Whenever this model makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll that attack's hit roll.

b60601f66994.name: Njal Stormcaller
b60601f66994.plain: This model knows Smite and 3 psychic powers from the Tempestas discipline.

bdae39c389a3.name: Berserker Rage
bdae39c389a3.plain: This model gets 3 extra attacks from its Shock Assault ability, instead of 1 extra attack.

c18d742462e0.name: Counter Charge
c18d742462e0.plain: Use in your opponent's Charge phase. Choose a SPACE WOLVES unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, it can make a Heroic Intervention as long as an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally of it, and its models can each move up to 6" when making that Heroic Intervention. Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies. This Stratagem costs 0CP if you choose a CHARACTER.

c41c7e147a9a.name: Tempest's Wrath
c41c7e147a9a.plain: Malediction, warp charge 6: if manifested, choose an enemy unit within 24" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made by that unit's models.

c4210da5738c.name: Elemental Shroud
c4210da5738c.plain:
Attacks against the bearer subtract 1 from their hit rolls, and it can't be shot from more than 18" away until it moves.
• Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against the bearer.
• The bearer can't be targeted by ranged attacks from a model more than 18" away. If the bearer makes any kind of move, it loses this second benefit until the start of your next Movement phase.

c57d587293f5.name: Explodes (Dreadnought)
c57d587293f5.plain: If this model drops to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, inflicting D3 mortal wounds on every unit within 3" of it.

c6fea2fa44ac.name: Tactical Precision (Aura)
c6fea2fa44ac.plain: Aura: while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

ca46db208c99.name: Rebellious Presence
ca46db208c99.plain: While another SPACE WOLVES unit from your army is within 3" of this model, subtract 1 from the Leadership of that unit's models.

cbd952255964.name: Beastslayer
cbd952255964.plain:
This WARLORD fights better against MONSTER and VEHICLE units.
• Add 1 to its Attacks characteristic while it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE units.
• Its attacks against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit add 1 to both the hit roll and the wound roll.

cd204adafccd.name: Cunning of the Wolf
cd204adafccd.plain: Use during deployment. Pick one SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY unit from your army. All its models gain the Outflank ability.

cd9eb0d87d46.name: Swift Hunters
cd9eb0d87d46.plain: This unit can declare a charge even in a turn in which it Advanced. Also, whenever it makes a pile-in or consolidation move, its models can move 1" further.

cdf2143ba2d3.name: Helfrost pistol
cdf2143ba2d3.plain: Roll a D6 whenever a model takes unsaved wounds from this weapon but isn't slain; on a 6, the target suffers a mortal wound.

d0af66accb02.name: Pack Killers
d0af66accb02.plain: Use after one of your STALKER PACK units has made a charge move. Choose a different STALKER PACK unit of yours within 12" of the charging unit. For the rest of that phase, when you make charge moves with the chosen unit, you can roll 3D6 and drop the lowest dice.

d0dad3d5ca4e.name: Blood Claws Hero (Aura)
d0dad3d5ca4e.plain: Aura: you can re-roll the hit roll for melee attacks made by BLOOD CLAWS, SKYCLAWS or SWIFTCLAWS models in your BLOOD CLAWS, SKYCLAWS or SWIFTCLAWS units while that unit is within 6" of this model.

d67754dd9638.name: Healing Balms
d67754dd9638.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this Wolf Priest can attempt to heal one model. Choose a unit within 3" of him that is SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY, BIKER or CAVALRY; if there is a wounded model in it, that model is healed, regaining up to D3 lost wounds immediately. No unit can be the target of Healing Balms more than once per turn.

dad1268edd7f.name: Wolfkin
dad1268edd7f.plain: For Shock Assault, this WARLORD always counts as having made a charge move, and it gets D3 extra attacks from that ability instead of 1.

dd23b048fab1.name: Savage Killers
dd23b048fab1.plain: If your army benefits from Combat Doctrines, the Assault Doctrine counts as active for your army for every attack made by a model in this unit. Also, for its Shock Assault ability, this unit always counts as having made a charge move.

de72d06e4fbd.name: Blood Scent
de72d06e4fbd.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Choose an enemy INFANTRY or MONSTER unit that has lost models, or that has a model with fewer wounds left than it started with. For the rest of that phase, STALKER PACK units from your army add 1 to wound rolls for their attacks against that enemy unit.

dfc2ddd7bc43.name: Hunter
dfc2ddd7bc43.plain:
Saga (Aura): while one of your SPACE WOLVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, it can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If that unit has the Swift Hunters ability, it can also declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Deed: this model makes a successful charge against an enemy unit.

e05adf973f87.name: Hunter
e05adf973f87.plain: Add 1 to this WARLORD's Advance and charge rolls, and it can charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

e06f835533b7.name: Tempest hammer
e06f835533b7.plain: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this weapon's attacks. Roll a D6 whenever a model takes unsaved wounds from this weapon but isn't slain; on a 6, the target suffers a mortal wound.

e07dadb0593b.name: Hunt from Afar
e07dadb0593b.plain: When this WARLORD makes a ranged attack against a unit that is neither a VEHICLE nor a MONSTER, unmodified hit and wound rolls of 2+ both succeed.

e95327c52315.name: Savage Fury
e95327c52315.plain: While the Assault Doctrine is active, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a melee attack by a unit with this ability scores 1 extra hit on the target.

ea3966ff0a6b.name: Hunters Unleashed
ea3966ff0a6b.plain:
Units with this tactic hit more easily in melee in turns they charge, are charged or Heroically Intervene, and can Heroically Intervene like CHARACTERS.
• Add 1 to the hit roll of a melee attack by a model with this tactic if, this turn, its unit was charged, made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention.
• Units with this tactic can make Heroic Interventions just like CHARACTERS.

ecec57695f3e.name: The Armour of Russ
ecec57695f3e.plain:
The bearer gets a 2+ save and a 4+ invulnerable save, and can hold back one enemy unit in the Fight phase.
• The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save and a Save characteristic of 2+.
• At the start of the Fight phase, you may choose one enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer. It can't fight this phase until all eligible units from your army have fought.

f1468a693557.name: The Pelt of Balewolf
f1468a693557.plain: Subtract 1 from both the hit roll and the wound roll of every melee attack made against the bearer.

f1d9a4f92684.name: Deed Worthy of a Saga
f1d9a4f92684.plain: Use in any phase, when a SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model in your army (excluding VEHICLE models) that has no Warlord Trait fulfils a Deed's requirements. At the end of that phase, that model gains the Deed's associated Saga ability for the rest of the battle.

f53f32350099.name: Totem of Storms
f53f32350099.plain: Once per battle round, you can re-roll one of this model's Psychic tests or Deny the Witch tests.

f99e1db29f26.name: Healing Balms
f99e1db29f26.plain: Use at the end of your Movement phase. Choose a model in your army with the SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY, SPACE WOLVES BIKER or SPACE WOLVES CAVALRY keyword that is within 3" of a SPACE WOLVES WOLF PRIEST of yours. It regains up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn.

faac30fc0e36.name: Mechanised Advance (Aura)
faac30fc0e36.plain: Aura: while one of your FIRE ANGELS VEHICLE models is within 6" of this model, that vehicle has a 6+ invulnerable save.

fcbef3e7d52f.name: A Glorious Death...
fcbef3e7d52f.plain: Whenever this model loses its last wound, roll a D6: on a 4+, it doesn't lose that wound. Also, if this model is slain in the Fight phase, then once the unit that killed it has made its attacks, you can attack with this model before it is removed as a casualty, even if it already attacked that phase.

fe45dfa3ebce.name: High King of Fenris
fe45dfa3ebce.plain: If this model is your Warlord, it always counts as having completed the Deed tied to its Warlord Trait.
